sam: quick sanity check — i flipped the fused-qkv+epilogue path on the gpu pool for canary traffic and saw tail latency spikes on long-chat sessions (seq_len ~2048). anyone else seeing paged-KV churn?

jia: saw it on one run. profiler shows lots of cudaMemcpy and kernel rebinds when page faults hit the paged-kv layer. looks like fusion changes memory layout, so our paged-kv heuristics stop coalescing.

anita: can you paste the perf summary?

jia: paste below (sanitized):
```
allocs: 78MB -> 320MB delta on request warmup
kernels: fused_attn_qkv_pack (avg 1.8ms) -> fallback_attn (avg 5.6ms) on pagefaults
cudaMemcpy H2D peaks during kv-evict: 12ms bursts
cache_hit_rate: 0.87 -> 0.62 after fusion
```

mike: omg that hit rate drop explains it. when fusion packs QKV we change per-token stride and evict heuristics assume contiguous layout. paged-kv page size 128KB gets fragmented.

sam: hmm. two hypotheses: 1) fused layout increases working set so paging happens, 2) our batcher merges seqs in a way that amplifies cross-request interference. either way kernel chooser should fallback earlier.

carmen: idea: add a cheap pre-kernel probe that estimates contiguous_kv_bytes for request batch and if < threshold, force non-packed kernel or smaller pack variant. cheap = read a few sample pointers, no full kernel launch.

anita: +1. we already have a microprobe for seq_len distribution in batcher. extend it to sample KV touch ranges.

mike: implementation sketch: in batcher before dispatch, compute estimated_kv_stride = avg(seq_len) * hidden_dim * bytes_per_fp; if estimated_kv_stride * batch_size > pool_coalesce_limit -> disable qkv-packing, enable bias/rope-only epilogue fusion.

jia: can we avoid OOM false positives? page footprint isn't just per-request stride, it's also cached prefixes. maybe use a hot-kv set heuristic: if recent cache_evictions > X within last Ys, degrade packing.

infra-bot: deploy check: pool "canary-gpu-3" currently has fused-qkv=true. cfg: `{
  kernel_policy: "auto",
  fused_qkv: true,
  pack_threshold: 1024,
  kv_page_size: 131072
}`

sam: action items:
- mike: prototype pre-kernel probe + pack disable flag (ETA tomorrow)
- jia: add eviction-rate metric + alert to perf dashboard
- anita: run controlled A/B on canary pool with pack disabled for long-chat flows

carmen: also add a small regression test in runtime test harness that simulates paged-kv + fused layout under heavy interleaving. can catch this earlier.

jia: logging note: when fallback happens, emit `kernel_fallback_reason=kv_fragmentation` with samples. helps postmortems.

sam: nice. if we get this in next patch we should roll to prod canaries and watch tail p95/p99. thanks all :thumbsup:

mike: pushing branch now -> PR in ~1h, will tag reviewers.

anita: i'll schedule the canary run after PR merges.

infra-bot: incident template: if p99 > 2x baseline for >10m, auto-rollback available.

sam: cool. keep updates in this thread and post perf diffs.
